claims.statement: Tom Allen, of Cleveland, was one of the seconds for Elliott when Elliott fought Gallagher on Pieche Island, Detroit River, on November 12, 1868.
claims.excerpt: Dan Brown, of New York; and Tom Allen, of Cleveland.

claims.statement: Elliott fought Gallagher for one hour and seventeen minutes over twenty-one rounds on Pieche Island.
claims.excerpt: The fight commenced at 2 08, and lasted one hour apd seveateen minutes

claims.statement: Elliott claimed the fight after a rough-and-tumble finish, and the referee decided in his favor.
claims.excerpt: Elliot claimed the fight, and the refcree decided in his favor.

notes: Allen was a second, not a fighter, in this bout. The hint called it travel, but seconding is kind other. The O'Baldwin and Wormald matter is not about Allen.
